name: 19.3.0 (September 9, 2026)
body:

Read the [React 19.3 release post](https://react.dev/blog/2026/09/09/react-19-3) for more information.

## New React DOM Features

- `browser()`: a new `react-dom` API that returns a usable which errors during server rendering and resolves in the browser. `use(browser())` inside a `<Suspense>` boundary marks a subtree as browser-only without reporting a recoverable error (@gnoff: [#37143](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37143), [#37241](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37241))
  - Added an `onBrowserBailout` option to the `react-dom/server` APIs to observe when a subtree defers to the browser (@gnoff [#37193](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37193))

## Notable changes

- Enable Trusted Types API integration (@rickhanlonii [#35816](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35816))
- Transitions now render independently instead of being entangled into a single render, so a slow transition no longer holds up unrelated ones (@acdlite [#37290](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37290))
- Added a DEV-only warning when a component appears to have been unblocked by calling `use()` conditionally (@hoxyq, @eps1lon: [#37104](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37104), [#37203](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37203), [#37491](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37491))

## All Changes

### React

- Fast Refresh Fixes
  - Fix Fast Refresh to find and remount edits to components wrapped behind `lazy()` (@sophiebits [#36965](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36965))
  - Fix Fast Refresh so edits to a `memo()` comparison function take effect (@sophiebits [#36964](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36964))
  - Fix Fast Refresh crash when an edit changes the kind of a component's type (@sophiebits [#36963](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36963))
  - Unify hot reload type resolution for Fast Refresh (@sophiebits [#36962](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36962))
  - Fix Fast Refresh to remount correctly when an edit changes the component kind (@sophiebits [#36950](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36950))
  - Double invoke effects in StrictMode after Fast Refresh (@eps1lon [#35962](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35962))
- Performance Track Fixes
  - Prevent crash when accessing `$$typeof` in Performance Tracks (@eps1lon [#35679](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35679))
  - Handle non-string function names in Performance Tracks (@eps1lon [#35659](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35659))
  - Use minus (`-`) instead of en dash for removed props in Performance Tracks (@eps1lon [#35649](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35649))
  - Handle arrays with bigints in deep objects in Performance Tracks (@eps1lon [#35648](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35648))
  - Don't enumerate typed array props in Performance Tracks in DEV (@UditDewan [#36913](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36913))
  - Bail out of diffing wide objects and arrays in Performance Tracks (@eps1lon [#34742](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34742))
  - Clear potentially large performance measures in DEV (@hoxyq [#34803](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34803))
  - Fix missing else branch for renders with no props change in Performance Tracks (@hoxyq [#34837](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34837))
- Activity Fixes
  - Fix `useSyncExternalStore` missing store mutations that happened while an Activity tree was hidden (@sophiebits [#36947](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36947))
  - Hide portal contents when an Activity is hidden (@acdlite [#35091](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35091))
  - Prevent metadata hoisting in hidden `<Activity>` trees (@ronnakamoto [#34983](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34983))
  - Prevent errors thrown inside a hidden Activity from escaping to the visible UI (@acdlite [#35074](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35074))
  - Don't unhide a node if a direct parent Offscreen is still hidden (@sebmarkbage [#34821](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34821))
  - Don't show internal `<Offscreen>` component in error messages (@rickhanlonii [#35763](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35763))
- Warn in DEV when a component appears to have been unblocked by a conditional `use()` (@hoxyq, @eps1lon: [#37104](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37104), [#37203](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37203), [#37491](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37491))
- Render transitions independently instead of entangling them into a single render (@acdlite [#37290](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37290))
- Fix hang when updating a dehydrated boundary inside a hidden tree (@gaearon [#37135](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37135))
- Don't reacquire Host Singletons during dev effect validation (@gnoff [#37113](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37113))
- Only remove properties from Host Singletons on release (@gnoff [#37112](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37112))
- Don't invoke effects on moved children in StrictMode (@sophiebits [#36948](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36948))
- Throw a clearer error when a rejected Promise is incorrectly instrumented (@eps1lon [#36328](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36328))
- Fix context propagation into Suspense fallbacks (@acdlite [#36160](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36160))
- Fix context propagation through suspended Suspense boundaries (@acdlite [#35839](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35839))
- Fix `useDeferredValue` getting stuck (@gaearon [#36134](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36134))
- Update `useActionState` error message to say "action state" instead of "form state" (@rickhanlonii [#35790](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35790))
- Don't warn when rendering data block scripts (@eps1lon [#35953](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35953))
- Treat fibers with alternates as mounted in `getNearestMountedFiber` (@sebmarkbage [#35578](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35578))
- Always instrument the lazy initializer thenable (@gnoff [#35521](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35521))
- Annotate cascading updates for DevTools performance tracks in DEV (@huntie [#34961](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34961))
- Resolve the `.default` export of a `React.lazy` as the canonical value (@sebmarkbage [#34906](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34906))
- Limit owner stacks to 10 frames (@eps1lon [#34864](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34864))
- Ensure `useEffectEvent` reads latest values in `forwardRef` and `memo()` components (@eps1lon [#34831](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34831))

### React DOM

- Copy `source` onto the synthetic `toggle` event (@lazerg [#37389](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37389))
- Update HTML parser rules for the new `<select>` parser (@josepharhar [#34804](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34804))
- Update `defaultValue` for `type="number"` inputs to match other input types (@sophiebits [#36980](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36980))
- Avoid setting `innerHTML` when it hasn't changed (@sophiebits [#36949](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36949))
- Forward the `nonce` option in `ReactDOM.preloadModule()` (@UditDewan [#36851](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36851))
- Support `fetchPriority` for module resources (@TheAlexLichter [#36835](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36835))
- Track stylesheet preloads when explicitly preloaded to avoid unnecessary suspension (@gnoff [#36386](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36386))
- Suggest correct casing for the misspelled `credentialless` iframe attribute (@vmx906 [#36322](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36322))
- Add `credentialless` as a recognized boolean attribute for iframes (@vmx906 [#36148](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36148))
- Prevent reentrant `finishedTask` from calling `completeAll` multiple times (@gnoff [#36287](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36287))
- Update the CSS shorthand property list (@kidonng [#35636](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35636))
- Support the `maskType` SVG prop (@sleitor [#35921](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35921))
- Add support for `onFullscreenChange` and `onFullscreenError` events (@chirokas [#34621](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34621))
- Include `submitter` in `submit` events (@eps1lon [#35590](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35590))
- Fire `onReset` when automatically resetting forms (@eps1lon [#35176](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35176))
- Use the `FormData` `submitter` parameter (@jenseng [#29028](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/29028))
- Fix form status reset when component state is updated (@eps1lon [#34075](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34075))
- Batch updates from `resize` events until the next frame (@eps1lon [#35117](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35117))

### React Server

- Add `nonce` to rendered import maps (@mattcosta7 [#37339](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37339))
- Add an `onBrowserBailout` option to observe subtrees that defer to the browser (@gnoff [#37193](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37193))
- Stop the caller's signal from retaining a finished render (@unstubbable [#37315](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37315))

- Fix `react-dom/server` hanging on Deno (@fraidev [#35235](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35235))
- Extend stack overflow recovery to retries in SSR (@jackpope [#36977](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36977))
- Fix false-positive hydration mismatch on `nonce` attributes (@MaxwellCohen [#37030](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37030))
- Guard shell-error callbacks instead of nulling them out on the request (@eps1lon [#36916](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36916))

- Treat an incomplete tree as an error during error recovery (@acdlite [#36911](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36911))
- Fix non-script `modulepreload` tracking (@fallintoplace [#36564](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36564))

- Track abort state on the request (@gnoff [#36583](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36583))

- Disallow abort reentrancy (@gnoff [#36574](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36574))
- Stop transpiling computed property names (@eps1lon [#36542](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36542))
- Fix crash when capturing the callsite of a stalled `use()` of a rejected Flight chunk (@lubieowoce [#36544](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36544))
- Double invoke effects in Strict Mode during hydration (@eps1lon [#35961](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35961))
- Add additional task reentrancy protections in Fizz (@gnoff [#36291](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36291))
- Don't outline Suspense boundaries with suspensey CSS during shell flush (@gnoff [#35824](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35824))

- Fix `useId` tracking on replay (@gnoff [#35518](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35518))
- Correctly handle replaying when hydrating (@gnoff [#35494](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35494))
- Simplify the `createSuspenseBoundary` path (@sebmarkbage [#35087](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35087))
- Unify preamble-only fields to save a field on Suspense boundaries (@sebmarkbage [#35068](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35068))
- Unify prerender-only fields to save a field on Suspense boundaries (@sebmarkbage [#35067](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35067))
- Push halted awaits to the owner stack for late-arriving I/O info (@unstubbable [#35019](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35019))
- Include all Node.js APIs in the Bun entrypoint for `react-dom/server` (@RiskyMH [#34193](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34193))
- Detach a Suspense boundary after flushing its segment (@gnoff [#34694](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/34694))

### React Server Components

- Keep an element pending while a referenced row is resolving (@unstubbable [#37542](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37542))
- Fix `RangeError` from exponential debug info growth (@unstubbable [#37481](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37481))

- Avoid main-thread stalls from large debug strings (@unstubbable [#36570](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36570))

- Fix dropped `FormData` entries in `decodeReplyFromBusboy` (@unstubbable [#36468](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36468))
- Harden types and improve performance of Flight replies (@eps1lon [#36425](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36425))
- Add more cycle protections to Flight replies (@eps1lon [#36236](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36236))
- Transport `AggregateError.errors` (@eps1lon [#36156](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36156))
- Bail out early when a backing entry for `Blob` deserialization is not a `Blob` (@eps1lon [#36055](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36055))
- Clear chunk reason after successful module initialization (@unstubbable [#36024](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/36024))
- Add support for transporting `Error.cause` (@eps1lon [#35810](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35810))
- Walk parsed JSON instead of using a reviver for faster RSC payload parsing (@timneutkens [#35776](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35776))
- Skip `transferReferencedDebugInfo` during debug info resolution (@unstubbable [#35795](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35795))
- Add `unstable_allowPartialStream` option to Flight Client (@unstubbable [#35731](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35731))

- Warn once if `eval` is disabled in the dev environment (@eps1lon [#35661](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/35661))
